mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: expect overcast skies along the Military Ridge State Trail with a first quarter moon phase, and while the ISS passes overhead tonight, you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.
The city has adopted the 2027 budget and is reminding residents to protect our sewer system by disposing of fats, oils, and grease in the trash to prevent clogs and backups.
We have plenty happening today including live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza with a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, plus trivia tomorrow at The Bogey Factory.
In a report from November 2, officers were dispatched to a residence on West End Circle where a 48-year-old man was arrested following a domestic disturbance.
Treat yourself to today's flavor, OREO Cookie Cheesecake, while visiting our local Culver's which is open today until 10 PM.
